description: Sleek and Modern Design Featuring a slim profile, this 19-inch monitor enhances any workspace or home setup with its sophisticated and clutter-free look. Vibrant and Detailed Display With a resolution of 1440×900 and the ability to produce 16.7 million colors, the monitor offers sharp, detailed visuals with lifelike accuracy, ideal for photos, videos, and games. Wide Viewing Angles and High Contrast Enjoy consistent picture quality from virtually any angle (H: 176o, V: 160o). The brightness range of 160-200cd/m2 and a contrast ratio of 1000:1 deliver deep blacks and bright whites, enhancing image depth and detail. Versatile Connectivity Equipped with VGA and HDMI ports, the monitor ensures easy connectivity to PCs, laptops, gaming consoles, and other devices, offering flexibility for various hardware setups. Energy Efficient with VESA Compatibility Designed for energy efficiency, it consumes less than 40W of power during operation and only 0.5W in standby mode. The monitor is VESA mount compatible (100x100mm), allowing easy wall or monitor arm mounting to save desk space and improve ergonomics.
